items.title: Apple wins dismissal of iCloud child abuse imagery lawsuit on Section 230 grounds
items.summary:

items.title: How the Escalating AI Wars Benefit You
items.summary: Apple goes thermonuclear on OpenAI, Musk and Altman trade jabs, and a subsidy price war rages between the labs — but NLW's read is that all this escalating acrimony is, at least for now, a gift to the rest of us. The competition has moved beyond frontier models to the entire ecosystem, and nobody has a handle on what shifts next.
